i.norm: Verifies that ofTaiSeconds normalizes a negative nanosecond adjustment by borrowing from the seconds field, and that withNano(0) zeroes the nanosecond part while preserving the (already normalized) seconds value. Also confirms that the original instant (with non-zero nanos) is correctly identified as after the zeroed copy. Input: ofTaiSeconds(-3113, -1194) -> floorDiv(-1194, 1_000_000_000) = -1 => seconds = -3113 + (-1) = -3114 -> floorMod(-1194, 1_000_000_000) = 999_998_806 => nanos = 999_998_806
Create an instant whose negative nano adjustment is normalized into the seconds field.
Zero out the nanosecond component; seconds remain unchanged after prior normalization.
The original instant has a large positive nano offset, so it is after the zeroed copy.
Both instants share the same normalized seconds value (-3114).
The original instant is after the zeroed copy because 999_998_806 ns > 0 ns.
